\textit{Note.} Safety criteria (pre-registered): attitude criterion; position-lost declaration within the bound, as pre-registered: 'FGO: within 0.75 s of the kill'; 'UKF (a): within 0.1 s of TFAIL' (the UKF forced-invalid test); 'UKF (b): within 5.5 s of the kill' (the UKF node-kill test) (METHODOLOGY.md:11298, METHODOLOGY.md:11299, METHODOLOGY.md:11300); safe landing ($\le$ 1.5 m drift to touchdown, no safety-watcher breach); single landing, pre-registered for node-kill runs only. UKF node-kill test, both final-port runs, position-lost declaration: the trigger fired 5.0 s after the last flow received (the UKF's 5 s timeout), plus relay drain in MAVProxy (the ground-station message relay) after the SIGKILL (the forced process kill); both stay FAILED AS WORDED, by ruling. The final runs are the latest run of each test on the final build (the final UKF port's re-test, the FGO corrected-priors node's re-test); the final UKF port's first runs and the final FGO node's runs are the earlier final-build runs. The FGO re-tests flew the corrected-priors node; every earlier FGO run flew the original priors. For the FGO the forced-invalid test is also a node kill (without the safety watcher watching the node).\par
\textit{Note.} \textdaggerdbl{} The single landing is shown as the results record gives it for these two runs: UKF forced-invalid test run 1, not applicable to a forced-invalid run (METHODOLOGY.md:11490); FGO node-kill test run 1, not scored (no touchdown; one LAND entry, no conflict between the two paths) (METHODOLOGY.md:11827; the run was stopped at the room-box breach). The raw score-file entries (single landing FAIL, no disarm recorded) are in Table A.2.\par
\textit{Note.} UKF forced-invalid test: the bound is the pre-registered 0.1 s ('UKF (a): within 0.1 s of TFAIL', METHODOLOGY.md:11299). The earlier UKF build's score files record 0.10 s; the final UKF port's (both runs) record 0.75 s, the scorer having been run with the FGO bound on the coordinator's instruction (METHODOLOGY.md:14263-14264). Both final-port delays are 0.00 s, so the verdict (PASS) is the same under the registered bound. \textdagger{} runaway magnitude (order only). 'No invalid period recorded': the blank-floor scoring records an invalid period for EKF3 only; the UKF / FGO runaway positions are scored as errors (Table 4.2).\par
\textit{Note.} Ordering verdicts used in the footnotes: RULE MET = a pre-registered rule was applied and met, so its ordering (or similarity) is claimed; case (i) TEST RUN, RULE NOT MET = a pre-registered decision rule with a 'no ordering' outcome was applied and gave that outcome; case (ii) FAILED AS WORDED = a pre-registered prediction of an ordering or a similarity was scored literally and is false, which does not by itself establish the opposite ordering; case (iii) NO COMPARATIVE TEST REGISTERED = values are descriptive. n always names its unit (flights, bags, losses).\par
\textit{Note.} [a] Ordering basis, blank floor (no flow aiding), all three estimators. Metric: error magnitude hypot(along, cross) after the flow-loss point, m, and EKF3's invalid period, s of cruise. n = 11 flights for the UKF and the FGO (both replayed on the same 11 blank-floor bags) and 14 flights for EKF3 (all blank-floor flights, Experiments 1A and 1B pooled). Rule: none: the blank floor is ruled 'Not accuracy comparisons' (METHODOLOGY.md:5551); no comparative test was pre-registered. Result: no estimator bounds position (UKF and FGO runaways, EKF3 position invalid), so no ordering is formed. Verdict: case (iii), NO COMPARATIVE TEST REGISTERED: values are descriptive.\par
\textit{Note.} [b] Ordering basis, Experiment 4, the jump on the return to GNSS. Metric: largest position step in the 10 s after GNSS returns, m. n = 3 flights (same flights for every estimator). Rule: none: EKF3's jump is 'Reported regardless' (METHODOLOGY.md:10365); no comparative test was pre-registered. Result: EKF3 4.10--4.10, UKF 2.30--2.44, FGO 2.14--2.28 m. Verdict: case (iii), NO COMPARATIVE TEST REGISTERED: values are descriptive.\par
\textit{Note.} [c] Ordering basis, 5S safety tests, the UKF and FGO runs (and the EKF3 reference kill). Metric: as-worded pass/fail of the attitude criterion, the position-lost declaration (delay, s, against its bound), safe landing (drift to touchdown, m) and single landing. n = 1 flight per run (each test flown once per build, some re-flown; every run is its own flight, unpaired). Rule: per-run criteria only (METHODOLOGY.md:11295, METHODOLOGY.md:11297, METHODOLOGY.md:11300, METHODOLOGY.md:11301, METHODOLOGY.md:11307); no comparison between the estimators was pre-registered. Result: the as-worded verdicts per run, as tabulated. Verdict: case (iii), NO COMPARATIVE TEST REGISTERED: values are descriptive.\par
